candidate_surfaces.right_carrier: Complete live reference-runtime operational state, including HTTP, persistence, scheduling, audit, backend, error, and retry behavior.
candidate_surfaces.state_space: Unbounded until every participant-relevant runtime and operational path is inventoried.
candidate_surfaces.initial_relation: Would require matching participant, audience, memory, exact cut, runtime snapshot, backend state, scheduler, and error surface.
candidate_surfaces.transitions_and_enabledness: Every semantic and runtime operation, persistence path, backend interaction, refusal, error, retry, and schedule must be included.
candidate_surfaces.label_and_projection_boundary: UUID, timestamp, HTTP, audit, persistence, and backend facts need a governed observer disposition and cannot be hidden by default.
candidate_surfaces.exact_relation: Divergence-preserving branching bisimulation only after the complete runtime carrier exists.
candidate_surfaces.dimensions: Concurrent, timed, scheduler-sensitive, persistence-sensitive, and backend-sensitive unless explicitly restricted.
candidate_surfaces.tau_and_divergence: Every live wait, retry, worker, persistence, and backend loop must be classified and matched.
candidate_surfaces.rationale: A crossing-kernel model cannot support a claim about the complete runtime.

candidate_surfaces.left_carrier: One closed revisioned policy realization over participant crossings.
candidate_surfaces.right_carrier: A second closed revisioned policy realization over the same crossing semantics.
candidate_surfaces.state_space: Policy, participant memory, supervisor visibility, release, exact cut, strategy, scheduler, environment, and order coordinates.
candidate_surfaces.initial_relation: Matching participant/audience state and declared policy-low-equivalent initial cuts.
candidate_surfaces.transitions_and_enabledness: Every decision, release, transformation, policy change, retry, observation, and memory effect in both configurations.
candidate_surfaces.label_and_projection_boundary: One revisioned participant/audience observation profile; matching projected histories alone is insufficient.
candidate_surfaces.exact_relation: Must be selected from branching, divergence-preserving, trace, or information-flow relations after the intended property is fixed.
candidate_surfaces.dimensions: Policy change, memory, strategy, scheduler, supervisor, order, time, probability, and concurrency remain profile coordinates.
candidate_surfaces.tau_and_divergence: Hidden policy or supervisor loops require explicit divergence treatment.
candidate_surfaces.rationale: Issue 811 does not select and close a second policy carrier.

candidate_surfaces.right_carrier: Independently derived complete reachable finite api-423-run-319-crossing-kernel@rev2 LTS.
candidate_surfaces.state_space: Closed singleton participant, audience, controller, episode, and request domains; two policy cuts; five input classes; finite decision, delivery, history, replay, and stage coordinates.
candidate_surfaces.initial_relation: The profile idle p0 states are related; the candidate witness family is induced by the concrete-to-abstract semantic abstraction.
candidate_surfaces.transitions_and_enabledness: Closed request, policy decision, transform/declassify, delivery/observation, cut-advance, and replay schemas plus finite concrete mediation stages.
candidate_surfaces.label_and_projection_boundary: participant-crossing-projection@rev1 with a closed visible alphabet and exactly five semantic internal classes mapped to checker action internal.
candidate_surfaces.dimensions: Finite possibilistic branching; sequential total order; untimed; non-probabilistic; no fairness; no partial order; fixed controller; finite visible exact-cut advance.
candidate_surfaces.tau_and_divergence: Concrete internal progress has a decreasing rank; structural deadlock, termination, and any infinite internal path remain explicit.
candidate_surfaces.rationale: It is the smallest existing surface with independent semantic, contract, runtime, and evidence authorities and a complete useful finite carrier.

candidate_surfaces.left_carrier: Complete operational state of one controlled backend realization.
candidate_surfaces.right_carrier: Complete operational state of a second controlled backend realization.
candidate_surfaces.state_space: Backend-native state, declared/effective capabilities, participant history, environment, scheduler, resource, time, and failure coordinates.
candidate_surfaces.initial_relation: Matching governed profiles, provisioned state, capability support, environment, scheduler, and participant history.
candidate_surfaces.transitions_and_enabledness: Every backend-native input, output, refusal, failure, retry, wait, and externally visible effect.
candidate_surfaces.label_and_projection_boundary: Backend internals require governed hiding; declarations and probes do not expose a complete transition carrier.
candidate_surfaces.exact_relation: Could require I/O alternating, divergence-preserving branching, probabilistic, timed, or failure-aware semantics.
candidate_surfaces.dimensions: Concurrency, time, probability, resource scheduling, partial order, and input ownership cannot be assumed away.
candidate_surfaces.tau_and_divergence: Uncontrolled backend wait and retry loops cannot be declared tau without evidence.
candidate_surfaces.rationale: Current backend evidence is bounded declaration and conformance evidence, not a complete carrier.

candidate_surfaces.left_carrier: A high-action system under one explicit hiding projection.
candidate_surfaces.state_space: High/low world state, participant memory, exact cut, release schedule, low strategy, scheduler, environment, and order.
candidate_surfaces.initial_relation: Matching policy-low-equivalent states, memory, cut, release, strategy, and environment.
candidate_surfaces.transitions_and_enabledness: Every high/low action, supervisor decision, declassification, purge, retry, policy change, and observation.
candidate_surfaces.label_and_projection_boundary: SEM-230 low observation; hidden high behavior still requires explicit divergence treatment.
candidate_surfaces.exact_relation: A named branching relation may support but cannot define a policy-noninterference lemma.
candidate_surfaces.dimensions: Adaptive strategy, scheduler, memory, release, order, time, probability, and concurrency must match SEM-230.
candidate_surfaces.tau_and_divergence: High-only divergence can leak progress or termination and must not be erased.
candidate_surfaces.rationale: It needs a separate preservation theorem and must not conflate bisimulation with noninterference.

theorem_profile.witness_family: All reachable concrete states paired with their semantic abstraction, plus the converse; membership must be validated as the greatest fixed point rather than assumed.

coordinates: exact policy resolution and independent gate results
expected-head atomic commit and refusal side effects
same-cut idempotency and later-cut replay rejection

transition_semantics.enabledness: Exactly the least reachable closure of the normative abstract and concrete transition schemas over the complete finite domains.
transition_semantics.branching: Visible decision, delivery, observation, replay, and cut choices are matched while intermediate tau states remain related to the same abstract branching point.
transition_semantics.progress: No progress property beyond the finite internal rank and explicit terminal states.
transition_semantics.declassification: visible governed decision and crossing.declassify label
transition_semantics.transformation: visible governed decision and crossing.transform label
transition_semantics.policy_change: visible p0-to-p1 policy.cut.advance when no request is in flight
transition_semantics.controller_handoff: outside profile because controller domain is singleton

nonclaims: No live-runtime realization until differential mapping evidence exists.
No result outside the exact complete finite carrier.

proof_tool_decision.drift_gate: Block when normative semantics, abstract model, concrete model, runtime mapping, profile, projection, source, or generated digests disagree.
proof_tool_decision.ci_gate: Run a fixed allowlisted offline command with bounded CPU, memory, time, output, safe repository-relative paths, all mutations, and canonical bounded artifact publication.
proof_tool_decision.independent_reproduction: A clean reviewer recomputes tool, source, model, profile, count, mutation, result, and artifact identities without reusing the producer result directory.
safe_artifacts: tool version and verified archive checksum or immutable container digest
canonical input, source, profile, projection, mapping, result, mutation, and bundle digests
complete finite domain, state, and transition counts
bounded safe result or counterexample summary
claim binding, limitations, explicit nonclaims, and reproduction decision

evaluated_tools.exact_relation_fit: Direct ltscompare support for divergence-preserving branching bisimulation and explicit action hiding.
evaluated_tools.counterexample_behavior: Supported relation failures can emit diagnostic formulas; divergence-only failures require an independent negative check if the exact mode emits no formula.
evaluated_tools.ci_viability: Deterministic noninteractive CLI and explicit LTS formats fit fixed offline resource-bounded CI.
evaluated_tools.reproduction: Pin 202607.0 plus verified archive checksum or immutable container digest, inputs, commands, counts, and digests.

evaluated_tools.exact_relation_fit: Finite temporal property checking is useful but property agreement is not a direct bisimulation decision without a relational product and checked invariant.
evaluated_tools.counterexample_behavior: Counterexample traces support deadlock, replay, atomicity, and progress checks.
evaluated_tools.ci_viability: Mature deterministic finite-state command line with explicit model configuration.
evaluated_tools.reproduction: Pinned tool/model/configuration and state statistics are independently replayable.

evaluated_tools.exact_relation_fit: Kernel-checked coinductive greatest-fixed-point definitions can support a parameterized or unbounded relation theorem.
evaluated_tools.counterexample_behavior: Failed proof obligations localize missing cases but are not primarily a counterexample generator.
evaluated_tools.ci_viability: Reproducible but materially higher formalization and maintenance cost for the first finite carrier.
evaluated_tools.reproduction: Pinned Isabelle session and checked theory artifacts support independent replay.

worked_evidence.relation_shape: Pair each abstract offered/decided/delivery state with the finite sequence of related concrete validation/resolution/capability/record/commit states around the same visible request, decision, delivery, and observation.
worked_evidence.evidence_boundary: One design-scale permit path demonstrates the candidate witness family but neither enumerates the carrier nor validates the greatest fixed point.

negative_mutations.safe_counterexample_obligation: Publish only bounded state ids, label class, profile/tool/input digests, and a sanitized diagnostic formula when supported.

negative_mutations.mutation: Add an internal self-loop at concrete policy resolution while the related abstract state remains nondivergent.
negative_mutations.safe_counterexample_obligation: Bind an independently checked explicit-divergence failure when no exact diagnostic formula is emitted.

negative_mutations.mutation: Remove the concrete crossing.delivery branch after a permitted transformation.
negative_mutations.safe_counterexample_obligation: Record the unmatched visible branch without raw payload or host details.

negative_mutations.mutation: Reuse the p0 result after policy.cut.advance instead of emitting crossing.replay.reject.
negative_mutations.safe_counterexample_obligation: Record only synthetic request/cut ids, visible label sequence, and bound digests.

requirement_dispositions.scope: Relation claim bindings, bounded evidence, model-check/proof classification, counterexamples, mapping, and conformance separation.
